title: Megawide shifts P1.23B in bond proceeds to 4PH housing

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Saavedra-led Megawide Construction Corp. is redirecting P1.23 billion in unused bond proceeds from transport-centric developments to housing projects under the government’s Pambansang Pabahay para sa Pilipino (4PH) program. Its board approved the reallocation on Friday, Oct. 9, according to a stock exchange disclosure. READ: Megawide bags P13B in new gov’t housing contracts The funds represent the remaining unutilized proceeds from Megawide’s Series A and B Fixed-Rate Bonds issued in 2022. They were originally earmarked for transport-centric development projects. Megawide said the change would channel the money to projects with “more immediate funding requirements” while supporting its long-term growth objectives […]...
